entries.title: SIKH FEUDATORY: Najibabad, AR rupee, Jagadhri, AH(12)21 year 47, PCGS AU58
entries.description: SIKH FEUDATORY: Najibabad, AR rupee, Jagadhri, AH(12)21 year 47, in the name of Shah Alam II, stylized katar, PCGS graded AU58. Najibabad was a Rohilla mint until 1774, when the town was taken over by Awadh. It then passed to the British in 1801 (AH1216-1217). According to Prinsep, operations at the Najibabad mint ceased with Rupees of regnal year 43 of Shah [x=#8216/]Alam II. Rupees with this mintname, with later dates and the Rohilla katar mintmark must have been struck elsewhere. There is reference to the "Old Jagadhree" (Jagadhri) rupee struck by one, Rani Sookum, of year 47.
